sanitizationPolicy: Historical workspace and user paths become relative origins or explicit @historical-* markers.
Original artifact hashes are retained separately from hashes of the published sanitized bytes.
Recorded internal file/hash references describe the historical artifact; they are not silently recomputed to pretend the sanitized copy is byte-identical.
limits: The integrity verifier checks packaged bytes and the final bank, not the truth of recorded observations.
Only replay adapters explicitly documented in docs/decision-verification.md rerun behavior.
Historical scripts remain archival source and are not directly executable as a complete portable suite.
Preserved batch evidence may include retired questions or earlier wording when needed to explain evidence reuse. The questions index alone defines the final 106 accepted items.
